dialogues.jp:
「そうだ、頼子さん。明日辺りにでも、どっか
　遊びに行かない？」
dialogues.en:
"It didn't work when I wanted to eat out last time, but you
were fine today."
dialogues.text:
"It didn't work when I wanted to eat out last time, but you
were fine today."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「遊びに……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, y-yes...... I was okay today......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, y-yes...... I was okay today......"

dialogues.jp:
紅茶をこくんと飲み干すと、頼子さんは目を丸
くした。
dialogues.en:
It seems like she hadn't even noticed the difference, and
she starts to sink into deep thought.
dialogues.text:
It seems like she hadn't even noticed the difference, and
she starts to sink into deep thought.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、は、はい……そう、ですね……」

自分でも、その違いに気づいていなかったのか、
頼子さんは考え込む顔付きになった。
dialogues.en: She says, choosing her words carefully,
dialogues.text: She says, choosing her words carefully,

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「たぶん……」
dialogues.en: "Maybe because I went outside by myself once......"
dialogues.text: "Maybe because I went outside by myself once......"

dialogues.jp: 言葉を選ぶような感じで、頼子さんは言う。
dialogues.en: "You got used to it."
dialogues.text: "You got used to it."

dialogues.jp: 実のところ、俺はホッとしていた。
dialogues.en:
I'm relieved to know that it isn't totally impossible for
her to go outside. I'd be worried if she could never do it
for the rest of her life.
dialogues.text:
I'm relieved to know that it isn't totally impossible for
her to go outside. I'd be worried if she could never do it
for the rest of her life.

dialogues.jp:
１２０パーセント確実に不可能という訳ではな
かったのだ。
dialogues.en: "So, what do you think about going out for fun?"
dialogues.text: "So, what do you think about going out for fun?"

dialogues.jp:
何かの表彰でも受け取るように、ぴしゃんと背
筋を正す。
dialogues.en:
As if she's receiving an award or a prize, she straightens
up in her seat.
dialogues.text:
As if she's receiving an award or a prize, she straightens
up in her seat.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「だ、大丈夫と……思います」
dialogues.en: "I think...... I will be okay."
dialogues.text: "I think...... I will be okay."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「こ、今度は、平気だと……そう、思うんです」
dialogues.en: "I think I can do it...... next time."
dialogues.text: "I think I can do it...... next time."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、ＯＫだね？」
dialogues.en: "So that means yes?"
dialogues.text: "So that means yes?"

dialogues.jp:
“怪奇！　茹でダコ女！”と化した頼子さんが、
こくりとうなずく。
dialogues.en: She looks like a boiled octopus monster as she nods.
dialogues.text: She looks like a boiled octopus monster as she nods.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、明日の夜ね」
dialogues.en: "Okay, so tomorrow night."
dialogues.text: "Okay, so tomorrow night."

dialogues.jp:
心はすでに明日のデート──これって、デート
だよな？　──に羽ばたいている。さて、どこ
に行くのがいいのやら……？
dialogues.en:
My heart's sprouted wings and it's already flying in the air
with joy about tomorrow's date --This is a date, isn't it?--
Well, where should we go......?
dialogues.text:
My heart's sprouted wings and it's already flying in the air
with joy about tomorrow's date --This is a date, isn't it?--
Well, where should we go......?

dialogues.jp:
「あ〜と、場所はまだ決めてないんだけど、何
　か、リクエストある？」
dialogues.en:
"I haven't decided where to go yet, but do you have anywhere
you want to go to?"
dialogues.text:
"I haven't decided where to go yet, but do you have anywhere
you want to go to?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「その……お任せします」
dialogues.en: "Please...... you pick a place."
dialogues.text: "Please...... you pick a place."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「俺に任せるたあ、いい度胸だ。じゃ、巣鴨と
　か？　お地蔵さんでも拝みに行こうか」
dialogues.en:
"You really want me to pick a place? Then, what about
Sugamo? Do you want to go to see old stone statues?"
dialogues.text:
"You really want me to pick a place? Then, what about
Sugamo? Do you want to go to see old stone statues?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……どこですか？」
dialogues.en: "......Where's that?"
dialogues.text: "......Where's that?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「知らない？　ローン会社じゃないぜ？」
dialogues.en: "You don't know Sugamo?"
dialogues.text: "You don't know Sugamo?"

dialogues.jp:
これ以上の会話は不毛になりそうなので、俺は
早々に打ちきった。
dialogues.en:
I know this isn't going to be a fun conversation, so I
quickly get back to the main subject.
dialogues.text:
I know this isn't going to be a fun conversation, so I
quickly get back to the main subject.

dialogues.jp:
「ともかく、適当に考えておくよ。ま、島の中
　だから、そんなに選択の幅はないんだけど」
dialogues.en:
"I'll think about it. But since we're on an island, there
aren't so many places to choose from."
dialogues.text:
"I'll think about it. But since we're on an island, there
aren't so many places to choose from."

dialogues.jp:
夏なら海水浴も出来るが、今の気温だと、海を
泳いでいるつもりで｛さんず／三途｝の川を渡ってました、
てな結果になりかねない。
dialogues.en:
If it were summer, we could go swimming at the beach, but
it's still too cold for that.
dialogues.text:
If it were summer, we could go swimming at the beach, but
it's still too cold for that.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、明日ね」
dialogues.en: "Let's talk about that tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "Let's talk about that tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: ぐいっとお茶を飲み干して、俺は席を立った。
dialogues.en: I finish up my tea and stand up from my chair.
dialogues.text: I finish up my tea and stand up from my chair.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 引き留めるような声に、ドアの所で振り返る。
dialogues.en:
I turn around at the door when I hear a pleading voice
behind me.
dialogues.text:
I turn around at the door when I hear a pleading voice
behind me.

dialogues.jp: 「あに？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そのぉ……」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ど、どうして……誘って下さったんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Wh-Why...... did you ask me out......?"
dialogues.text: "Wh-Why...... did you ask me out......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あーと、それは……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, that's because......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, that's because......"

dialogues.jp:
正直に言うべきか否か。一瞬の攻防が脳内で繰
り広げられ、結局“無難”に軍配が上がった。
dialogues.en:
Should I be honest and tell her the true reason or not? I
have a little battle in my brain and finally declare 'a safe
answer' the winner.
dialogues.text:
Should I be honest and tell her the true reason or not? I
have a little battle in my brain and finally declare 'a safe
answer' the winner.

dialogues.jp:
「……まあ、メイドさんとして良く働いてくれ
　てるから、ちょっとしたお礼ってところ」
dialogues.en:
"...You can think of it as my thanks to you for working hard
as a maid."
dialogues.text:
"...You can think of it as my thanks to you for working hard
as a maid."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「そ、そうですよね。あ……私、食器片づけちゃ
　いますね」
dialogues.en: "Oh, okay. Ah...... I'll clean up the table."
dialogues.text: "Oh, okay. Ah...... I'll clean up the table."

dialogues.jp:
なぜかあたふたと、食器をがしゃがしゃ言わせ
て、台所へ消えていった。
dialogues.en:
She picks up the plates in a hurry and rushes to the
kitchen.
dialogues.text:
She picks up the plates in a hurry and rushes to the
kitchen.

dialogues.jp: 何か、妙な雰囲気だったような……？
dialogues.en: She looked strange......?
dialogues.text: She looked strange......?

dialogues.jp: ◆頼子さんを誘う◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
夕食時、思い付きを装って、頼子さんをデート
に誘ってみた。
dialogues.en:
I ask her when we're having tea, after the dinner of
handmade-hamburgers in a gravy sauce, salad, and consomme
soup.
dialogues.text:
I ask her when we're having tea, after the dinner of
handmade-hamburgers in a gravy sauce, salad, and consomme
soup.

dialogues.jp:
今日は外に出ても大丈夫だったんだし、大丈夫
だと思ったのだ。
dialogues.en:
I try to sound like I just thought of the idea, but the
truth is that I've been thinking about it for hours.
dialogues.text:
I try to sound like I just thought of the idea, but the
truth is that I've been thinking about it for hours.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは顔を真っ赤にしながらも承知してく
れた。
dialogues.en: "For fun......?"
dialogues.text: "For fun......?"

dialogues.jp:
何で誘ってくれたのかという彼女の問いに、俺
はついつい無難な答えを返してしまう。
dialogues.en: She takes the last sip of her tea, looking surprised.
dialogues.text: She takes the last sip of her tea, looking surprised.

dialogues.jp: すると何故だか、奇妙な雰囲気が流れた……。
dialogues.en:
"Yes. You're not scared to go outside any more if you're
with me, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Yes. You're not scared to go outside any more if you're
with me, right?"
